topic: Budwel's emergence as a premier destination for luxury living and real estate investment in Hyderabad.
key_points: Budwel offers unmatched proximity to the Outer Ring Road (ORR) and major IT hubs.
The area provides a balanced lifestyle surrounded by lakes, an ecological park, and green spaces.
Strong government-led infrastructure includes 120-ft and 150-ft arterial roads and underground utilities.
Prestige Spring Heights and mixed-use developments are creating a vibrant, self-sustained urban ecosystem.
local_facts: Budwel is located just about 300 metres from the Outer Ring Road (ORR).
The layout features planned 120-ft and 150-ft arterial roads.
Prestige's mixed-use development is located at Plot Nos. 9 and 10 in the Budwel layout.
